question: Which goddess is to be placed in the pericarp as the remover of the fear of Mahākāla?
premises: The location specified is the pericarp.
The goddess is described as removing fear.
The fear removed is associated with Mahākāla.
inference: The goddess who removes the fear of Mahākāla is to be placed in the pericarp.
plain_english: Then, in the pericarp, the goddess who removes the fear of Mahākāla.
